name: visiting-hours-dream-art-flow-batch
title: Visiting Hours: the dream's cast and the house's story pictures
subtitle: Made 2026-10-11 with Flow (Nano Banana Pro, 0 credits), cut out and cropped into Art/Dream/ under the names the builders read. Top: the whole dream cast as sticker cut-outs; then the photo wall, the fridge calendar and Theo's drawing; then every take (green = my pick).
questions: The two neighbours and the dog: do they sit with Walt, Lena and Theo as one cast (the same crayon, chibi, one strong colour each)?
Theo's drawing has a small fourth figure with a dark bun apart at the edge (the aunt, Nadia). Keep it, or leave her out?
The photo wall's six moments (wedding, newborn, first bike, beach, his tenth birthday with his aunt, dad and son asleep): right, or should the memories show something else?
notes: Judged defects first. Rejected: Theo's drawing take 2 (readable words: 'Dad', 'Mum', 'Hamster'); the calendar takes printed readable day names and a title, so the pick has them painted out with the paper colour (the grid, doodles and magnets stay); the rose neighbour's take 2 (a water spray that the cut-out would break up).
Theo's drawing: a few letters of stray writing at the top-left corner were patched over with nearby crayon sky (a faint seam if you look closely).
Not yet seen in Unity: the pictures appear on the photo wall, the fridge and Theo's desk after main's rebuild.
